items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: it's like that story about Toscanini, years before tape, listening to this recording of Mozart.

ctx.x: There's one for each instrument in the band. You don't have to follow dynamics. If they don't like what you did the guy will sit in the control booth -- it's like that story about Toscanini, years before tape, listening to this recording of Mozart. In the booth he turns to the guy in the control room and said, "That's not Mozart, that's not me, that's you." He said, "Go home, set all the dials in the middle and sit on your hands. We make the dynamics, not you." But those days are gone. And now it's a man in the…
That's right. What do they call it, after the workers leave they have a session where they balance.
